story.title: Our Story
story.headline: From the heart of nature to your glass
story.introLead: Vigor Fructus comes from a love of cocktail culture and the wish to bring real fruit — dried, concentrated, uncompromising — into every glass.
story.quote: We believe every cocktail deserves a touch of nature. Our dried fruit isn’t just garnish — it’s craft.
story.beginningP1: We started as a small family idea: that premium bartenders and cocktail lovers in Serbia should have fruit that looks as good as it smells — ideal for garnish and the final flourish in a drink.
story.beginningP2: Day by day we expand our range, choose suppliers who share our standards, and learn from the people behind the bar.
story.philosophyP1: For us, quality isn’t an empty word — it’s fruit selection, drying temperature control and respect for shelf life so aroma stays intact. Every batch is checked by us before it reaches you.
story.philosophyP2: We believe in sustainability and in how a simple ingredient can turn an ordinary cocktail into something memorable. That’s the promise in every package.
story.processTitle: From the orchard to your table
story.step1Desc: We hand-pick only the finest fruit from trusted suppliers across the region.
story.step2Desc: A careful low-temperature drying process preserves nutrients.
story.step3Desc: Eco-friendly packaging that protects the product and the environment.
story.ctaDesc: Discover why top bartenders and cocktail enthusiasts across Serbia choose us.
